messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

General Dosing Notes:
- Fluoxetine is usually taken in the morning to minimize the risk of sleep disturbances
- It may take several weeks to feel the full benefit of fluoxetine, do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor first
- Your doctor will periodically reassess whether you need to continue treatment
- Older adults may need a lower dose or may take fluoxetine less frequently than younger adults
- People with liver problems may also require a lower or less frequent dose
- If you have other medical conditions or take multiple medications, your doctor may need to adjust your fluoxetine dose accordingly

The relation 'has benefit onset time' in the triplet is defined as 'The full therapeutic benefit of the subject drug may take the duration specified by the object entity to become apparent.' Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. A. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
B. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
C. 'has half life': The subject drug remains in the body for the duration specified by the object entity.
